scripts.deploy:web: expo export --platform web && firebase deploy --only hosting
scripts.test: node --experimental-strip-types --test src/utils/planningBillRules.test.ts src/utils/deliveryRules.test.ts src/utils/chatMessagePipeline.test.ts src/utils/chatMessageMutations.test.ts src/utils/listenerOwnership.test.ts src/utils/rankingGamification.test.ts src/utils/consultationScheduling.test.ts src/utils/sessionDiagnostics.test.ts src/utils/asyncPool.test.ts src/utils/rankingCache.test.ts src/utils/keyboardOverlap.test.ts src/utils/badgeColor.test.ts src/utils/rankingPosition.test.ts src/utils/crowns.test.ts src/utils/rankingListConfig.test.mjs src/utils/publicGamificationProfile.test.ts
scripts.eas:publish:expo-go: CI=1 eas update --branch preview --message "Preview cliente Expo Go" --non-interactive
scripts.eas:apk-url: eas build:list --platform android --profile preview --limit 1 --json --non-interactive | node -e "let d='';process.stdin.on('data',c=>d+=c);process.stdin.on('end',()=>{const j=JSON.parse(d);const u=j[0]?.artifacts?.applicationArchiveUrl;if(u)console.log(u);else{console.error('Nenhum build preview encontrado');process.exit(1)}});"
